title: Alginate Hydrogels for Three-Dimensional Organ Culture of Ovaries and Oviducts
protocol: Prepare a 0.5% (w/v) solution of sodium alginate using sterile PBS.
Heat the sodium alginate solution to 37°C.
Mix the sodium alginate by inversion or rocking, avoiding vortexing.
Draw the heated alginate into a 1 ml syringe with a 25 G needle and maintain at 37°C.
Prepare a 10 mM sterile CaCl2 solution for crosslinking and warm it to 37°C.
Prepare 1 mL of culture medium (αMEM + 5 units penicillin and 5 μg/ml streptomycin) per well in a 24 well plate for each experiment.
Include various drugs, peptides, or viruses in the culture medium.
Incubate tissue with Lipofectamine 2000 and plasmid DNA for four hours at 37°C for transfection prior to organ encapsulation.
Euthanize animals by CO2 asphyxiation followed by cervical dislocation.
Dissect organs from the animal, removing any fat or residual tissue.
Gently pull off the bursa membrane surrounding the ovary and cut the ovary into four pieces.
Uncoil the oviduct gently by pulling apart connecting membranes and extending ends in opposite directions using forceps before cutting it into pieces.
Place a single alginate droplet (~1-3 μL) onto a sterilized mesh fiber.
Move a piece of organ into the alginate droplet using sterile forceps.
Center the alginate droplet containing the tissue using forceps or a sterile needle.
Invert the droplet containing the organ piece by grasping the mesh fiber with sterile forceps.
Tap the forceps on the edge of a 10cm petri dish containing 10mM CaCl2 solution so that the drop falls into solution.
Incubate for 2 minutes.
Remove with sterile spoon and transfer into culture medium.
Culture for a defined time period.
Incubate cultures in alginate lyase (3.4 mg/ml) dissolved in Leibovitz's L-15 media at 37°C for 30 minutes or until gel is completely dissolved.
Incubate the organoid with 500 units of collagenase in Leibovitz's L-15 media for 1 hour.
Vortex in 2 second pulses (2 seconds vortex and 2 seconds rest) on medium power for 1 minute.
Vortex in 1 second pulses (1 second vortex and 1 second rest) for 1 minute.
Let organ pieces fall to bottom of microcentrifuge tube.
Pipette supernatant into fresh sterile microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge 3 minutes at 3000 rpm to pellet ovarian surface epithelium.
Cut the tube lengthwise and place on tissue culture plastic in DMEM containing 5 units penicillin, 5 μg/ml streptomycin, and 4% (v/v) FBS.
Allow cells to "crawl" out of the tubal stroma over 3-5 days.
Collect alginate encapsulated bead from the culture medium at selected time point.
Drop culture into sterile 10mM CaCl2 solution for two minutes to recrosslink alginate.
Fix alginate encapsulated organ in 2% paraformaldehyde containing 50 mM sucrose, 10 mM CaCl2, and 50 mM sodium cacodylate.
Embed the entire alginate-encapsulated organ culture piece into paraffin.
Generate 5 μm sections with a microtome.
Cut ovaries into different size pieces for organ culture.
Incubate ovaries in serum-free αMEM to observe single layer of ovarian surface epithelium after culturing for 7 days.
Add insulin at 5 μg/ml to cultures and incubate for 7 days to induce hyperproliferation of ovarian surface epithelium and formation of multiple layers of cells.
Add bromodeoxyuridine at a final concentration of 10 μM to the cultures 24 hours prior to fixation to measure cell proliferation.
